comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body: I'd say it's technically possible but highly likely that it had access to a community material library or something. Otherwise it got insanely lucky. But I'm not buying that it was one-shot without a library. Depends in part on engine though. Certain engines are more conducive to procedural materials/meshes and the AI seems to work better with them. Three.js, for instance, Claude does particularly well with genning procedural low poly assets, either because of how it was trained or information it finds online, or maybe a combination of both.
